name: google-calsync
description: Outlook to Google Calendar sync scripts for Google Apps Script (HTML, iCal, and Graph variants)

scripts.check: node scripts/check.js html ical && cd graph && node scripts/check.js
scripts.push:html: node scripts/check.js html && cd html && clasp push
scripts.push:ical: node scripts/check.js ical && cd ical && clasp push
scripts.push:graph: cd graph && node scripts/check.js && node test/sync.test.js && clasp push
